title: Case 038: Account confirmation available in the secure portal
initial_request: I need a bank document confirming my account relationship for my records. Please make it available to me in the secure portal; I am not asking for a transfer.
overview: Mara Ellison requested an account confirmation through H&V’s secure portal and escalated the request in secure chat. After checking that the request was from the verified account holder, the agent asked the document service to issue the permitted confirmation to her secure portal only. The document service confirmed that the file was available there.

next_action.summary: Submit a request to the document service to issue the permitted account confirmation in Mara’s secure portal only.

outcome: The account confirmation is available in the secure portal. Whether Mara or any intended recipient uses it is not confirmed.

events.body: I need a bank document confirming my account relationship for my records. Please make it available to me in the secure portal; I am not asking for a transfer.

Issued: account-confirmation-038.pdf. Status: available to the verified account holder in the secure portal. Account relationship: active at issue date, 1 October 2025.

Your account confirmation is available in your secure portal as account-confirmation-038.pdf. It is dated 1 October 2025 and states that the account relationship was active at the issue date; it is not a payment instruction.
